An '''airport''' was located in the north of [[Shulell City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]]. It dealt with all sub-[[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] traffic traveling to and from the [[City/Legends|city]], and handled [[Freighter/Legends|barges]] full of ore from the domestic [[Mining/Legends|mines]].
